description: Implementation of ItemService for managing items, including adding, fetching, and deleting items with associated file upload handling.

classes.name: ItemServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing item management functionalities including add, fetch, and delete operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item with an uploaded file, associates it with a category, and returns the item response.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts ItemRequest DTO to ItemEntity, assigning a new UUID.

methods.name: fetchItems
methods.description: Retrieves all items and converts them to response DTOs.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item by ID and removes its associated image file from storage.
